uncited: *   **Triplane Feature Maps:** Three learnable parameter tensors $F_{XY}, F_{YZ}, F_{XZ}$ representing features on orthogonal planes.
**Encode Position:** Project the 3D shading point $p$ onto three orthogonal planes.
Sample features $F_{XY}, F_{YZ}, F_{XZ}$ from each plane using bilinear interpolation.
**Evaluate MLP:** Pass the input vector through the MLP.
**Compute Visibility:** Calculate a soft visibility value $v$ from the diffuse direct light pass.
Convert the diffuse direct pass to grayscale using the luminosity method.
**Dataset Generation:** Generate supervised data using Blender.
Render physically-based, path-traced clouds under varying viewing and lighting conditions.
Extract mesh representation from volumetric density field.
**Loss Function:** Apply logarithmic transformation $\log(x + 1)$ to both predictions $(\tilde{c}, \alpha)$ and ground-truth RGBA values.
Initial learning rate $10^{-3}$, halved every 50 epochs.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires storage for triplane feature maps and MLP weights.
